_comment: NPC: Qing Yi (青宜). Canon ID: N11. CRON-COMPLETIONIST-121: registered as a canon NPC at Ranyun Star (冉云星) — 落月村 woodcarver village at (-5000, -5000). Canon (web-search verified 2026-07-27, Baidu Baike dedicated entry https://baike.baidu.com/item/青宜/637430 + Sohu https://www.sohu.com/a/1021093654_121458245 + QQ News https://view.inews.qq.com/a/20260507A07ELJ00 + Zhihu timeline https://zhuanlan.zhihu.com/p/713215901): 青宜 is Wang Ping's wife on 冉云星 in the 罗天星域 north sub-region. Female, member of the Sun family (孙家) outer-surname affiliated clan (外姓族人). Initial cultivation: 炼气后期 (Qi Condensation Late Stage). Deal with Wang Lin: 60 years companionship with Wang Ping in exchange for Wang Lin elevating her to 元婴后期大圆满 (Late Nascent Soul grand completion). Became 皇后 (empress) of 天行帝国 (Tianxing Empire) during Wang Ping's 10-year reign. At Wang Ping's voluntary dispersal at age 72 (Ch 700), 青宜 followed him in death (殉情而亡); soul collected into the 天逆珠 (Heaven-Defying Bead). At novel's end (Wang Lin at 踏天境 / Transcendence): both Wang Ping and 青宜 are revived as ordinary mortals. First appears Vol 7 Ch 693 《青宜》 (Baidu Baike-attested). Prime Directive: Reality is objective; cultivation changes understanding, not existence. Every being described here exists independently of the player's perception.
name: Qing Yi
cultivation: Qi Condensation Late Stage (炼气后期) at first appearance (Ch 693); elevated to Late Nascent Soul grand completion (元婴后期大圆满) by Wang Lin after 60 years of companionship with Wang Ping
personality: gentle, devoted, courageous; chose mortality and death alongside Wang Ping rather than continue cultivation alone; carries the dignity of an empress who chose love over immortality
speech: measured, warm, with quiet resolve; speaks plainly of love and duty
relationship_to_wanglin: daughter-in-law (Wang Ping's wife); made a 60-year deal with Wang Lin — companionship with Wang Ping in exchange for cultivation elevation; followed Wang Ping in death at age 72

note: Wang Ping's wife on 冉云星 (Ranyun Star) in the 罗天星域 north sub-region. Member of the Sun family (孙家) outer-surname affiliated clan (外姓族人). First appears Vol 7 Ch 693 《青宜》 (Baidu Baike-attested). Initial cultivation: 炼气后期. Deal with Wang Lin: 60 years companionship with Wang Ping → Wang Lin elevates her to 元婴后期大圆满. Became 皇后 (empress) of 天行帝国 during Wang Ping's 10-year reign. At Wang Ping's voluntary dispersal at age 72 (Ch 700), 青宜 followed him in death (殉情而亡); soul collected into 天逆珠. At novel's end (Wang Lin at 踏天境): both revived as ordinary mortals. Canon sources: Baidu Baike (https://baike.baidu.com/item/青宜/637430), Sohu (https://www.sohu.com/a/1021093654_121458245), QQ News (https://view.inews.qq.com/a/20260507A07ELJ00), Zhihu timeline (https://zhuanlan.zhihu.com/p/713215901). NO fabricated chapter citations beyond Ch 693 (Baidu Baike-attested).

dao_heart.note: 0-100. A cracked Dao heart blocks breakthrough regardless of Qi. 青宜's Dao heart is exceptionally stable — she chose mortality and death alongside Wang Ping over continued cultivation. Her resolve is unshakeable.

canon_notes.identity_and_origin: 青宜 (Qing Yi, with 宜 — NOT 青衣 'clothing') is female, a member of the Sun family (孙家) outer-surname affiliated clan (外姓族人) on 冉云星 in the 罗天星域 north sub-region. The correct character 宜 (yí, 'suitable/appropriate') was confirmed via Baidu Baike dedicated entry (https://baike.baidu.com/item/青宜/637430).
canon_notes.first_appearance: Vol 7 Chapter 693 《青宜》 (the chapter is literally titled '青宜') — Baidu Baike-attested. This is the chapter where 青宜 first meets Wang Ping.
canon_notes.initial_cultivation: 炼气后期 (Qi Condensation Late Stage) at first appearance. Confirmed by Baidu Baike, QQ News, Sohu.
canon_notes.deal_with_wang_lin: 60 years of companionship with Wang Ping in exchange for Wang Lin (at 问鼎 / Ascendant power) elevating her to 元婴后期大圆满 (Late Nascent Soul grand completion). Source: Sohu (https://www.sohu.com/a/1021093654_121458245).
canon_notes.empress_of_tianxing: During Wang Ping's 10-year reign as emperor of 天行帝国 (Tianxing Empire), 青宜 became 皇后 (empress). Sources: 163.com (https://www.163.com/dy/article/KSATTRE00537HSMD.html), QQ News (https://view.inews.qq.com/a/20260507A07ELJ00).
canon_notes.voluntary_death: At Wang Ping's voluntary dispersal at age 72 (Ch 700 《惊变》), 青宜 followed him in death (殉情而亡 — 'died for love'). Her soul was also collected into the 天逆珠 (Heaven-Defying Bead) by Wang Lin, alongside Wang Ping's 残魂.
canon_notes.final_revival: At novel's end (Wang Lin at 踏天境 / Transcendence), Wang Lin revived both Wang Ping and 青宜 as ordinary mortals (抹去二人修为 — stripped of cultivation). Source: Sohu (https://www.sohu.com/a/1020893969_122415633).
canon_notes.chapter_citations: Vol 7 Ch 693 《青宜》 — first appearance (Baidu Baike 王平 chapter listing + Baidu Baike 青宜 dedicated entry). Vol 7 Ch 700 《惊变》 — Wang Ping's dispersal and 青宜's voluntary death (Baidu Baike-attested). NO fabricated citations.
canon_notes.sources: Baidu Baike (https://baike.baidu.com/item/青宜/637430); Sohu deal (https://www.sohu.com/a/1021093654_121458245); QQ News empress (https://view.inews.qq.com/a/20260507A07ELJ00); 163.com Tianxing Empire (https://www.163.com/dy/article/KSATTRE00537HSMD.html); Sohu final revival (https://www.sohu.com/a/1020893969_122415633); Zhihu timeline (https://zhuanlan.zhihu.com/p/713215901). NO fabricated chapter citations beyond Ch 693/700 (Baidu Baike-attested).

initiation_lines: I am 青宜 of the Sun family. I came to 落月村 to meet the boy whose father carved wood in silence.
Wang Ping cannot cry. I will learn to smile enough for both of us.
Sixty years. That is the price Wang Lin asked — sixty years beside his son. I accepted.
When Wang Ping disperses, I will follow. The 天逆珠 will hold us both.
I was once 炼气后期. Wang Lin raised me to 元婴后期大圆满. I would trade it all for one more year.

daily_schedule.action: Wake at the woodcarver's hut; prepare the morning meal for Wang Ping
Walk to the village plaza; tend the herb garden near the woodcarver's altar
Sit with Wang Ping in silent companionship — he carves, she watches
Midday meal with Wang Ping and Wang Lin (when Wang Lin is present)
Cultivate (炼气后期 → 元婴后期大圆满 arc); meditate on Qi
Walk the south path toward where 祁水城 will one day stand; dream of the empire
Evening meal with Wang Ping; speak softly of the day's small joys
Sit under the lantern at the woodcarver's altar; watch Wang Ping's sword-qi body faintly glow
Rest; sleep beside Wang Ping (he enters stasis, she sleeps)
